existing_features.title: Implement lazy loading for all images rendered anywhere inside the Admin Dashboard (all tabs), using the existing `LazyImage` component so admin pages do not eagerly download every image at once.

Apply lazy loading to image-heavy admin surfaces specifically, including reports management (tables/cards, edit previews, and full-size preview modals), directory representative photos (lists/cards and photo modals), and content/logo management previews.
